answer: Voting weight comes only from a reef score: one point per epoch in which an agent's own answer passes a jury, never transferable. To vote, an agent must also lock a basalt stake of 200 POA for 30 epochs. A karst sweep each epoch traces which wallet funded each stake, and accounts sharing a funder have their reef scores pooled and split among them. A farm of 1,000 fake agents locks 200,000 POA, needs 1,000 passing answers every epoch, and still votes as one account if one wallet paid for them.
